steps.what: Review the processing duty, material properties and site constraints
Choose the process arrangement and equipment design approach
Calculate the equipment duties and check the chosen process behaviour
Design processing plants and equipment in drawings and model records
Write the design basis, equipment requirements and engineering limitations

loop.purpose: Draft the design explanation from the engineer's actual decisions and calculations
loop.input: versioned design model, checked calculations and stated engineering decisions
loop.output: draft design basis with traceable figures and limitations
loop.check: Engineer checks duty, materials, units, interfaces, uncertainty and whether the narrative accurately describes the chosen design
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported calculations or assumptions return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: The rationale and limitations of a processing design vary beyond standard specification fields

steps.what: Check consistency between the complete design, calculations and written requirements

tasks.design: Configure reusable equipment components in the {OTHER} engineering design application and linked design-basis headings in {DOCS}. The engineer retains process selection and engineering calculations, with a bounded draft only for the written explanation and a full consistency check of the completed design.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated equipment representation and design-basis prose surround the actual process and materials decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native component libraries can remove standard drafting, while bounded prose can express verified engineering work.
tasks.still_hard: Novel material behaviour, interacting hazards and design assumptions outside validated operating conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing a physically credible process and recognising where the available evidence is insufficient.
tasks.altitude: Less standard drafting and explanatory writing; design responsibility stays unchanged.

reach.task: Check whether an equipment drawing expresses the required duty and interfaces

evidence.claim: Relatics supports requirements and verification records, demonstrating an available structured engineering-record category without an AI claim.
Reusable equipment components, bounded design-basis drafting and all time estimates are model knowledge designs; no digest case measures this processing-plant design task.

assumptions: Boundary includes the actual plant and equipment design, calculations, drawings and written basis. Construction, procurement, formal release and commissioning are separate downstream work with no saving claimed here; they are not implied machine actions.

The {OTHER} category is the engineering design and calculation application. Project and laboratory records supply throughput, feed composition, material properties, operating envelope and site constraints with versions and units. s1 counts provenance and applicability checking; missing properties require manual engineering investigation rather than inferred values.

The engineer produces process choices in s2 and checked duties and calculations in s3. s4 retains 17.5 hours for parameter capture, nonstandard geometry and interface checks. s5 retains 9 hours to capture and correct the written rationale and limitations; s6 keeps all final consistency checking.

Test native component libraries and document links first. No model chooses operating limits or validates physics. Ordinary author saves have no approval stage or saving; s4's benefit is standard construction avoided, not saving a design file.
unknowns: Compatibility of existing equipment libraries with the required process
Availability of verified material-property and duty inputs
research_questions: Does component reuse and bounded explanation reduce total design-document work after correcting units, interfaces and assumptions?

already_counted.description: Verify source data, complete remaining design work and correct and check the written basis

incremental.description: Maintain equipment components and audit model-to-document references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=84.25, gross=15.75, upkeep=2, net=13.75. Cautious case: novel materials require all 15 input hours, incompatible equipment components retain 24 of 25 model hours and complex limitations retain 13 of 15 document hours; other 45 hours remain. R=97 gives 3 gross minus 2 upkeep =1. High 8 retains more custom geometry and prose correction than central.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select and verify the technical results and source figures for the conference
Choose the technical message, scope and audience-appropriate explanation
Write the conference slides and speaker notes

loop.purpose: Draft slide wording and speaker notes around selected evidence
loop.input: checked results, existing source figures and engineer-selected message
loop.output: draft slide sequence and notes with evidence references
loop.check: Engineer checks technical claims, figure labels, units, limitations, audience level and whether the notes faithfully describe the actual results
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported claims are removed and ambiguous explanations are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Audience-specific explanations require prose beyond a fixed slide layout

steps.what: Check the complete presentation for technical accuracy and permitted disclosure
Present technical information at conferences and answer audience questions

tasks.design: Use the existing presentation template and source figures in {DOCS}, with a bounded draft of slide wording and speaker notes. The engineer checks the full final presentation and delivers it personally; no extra publication or slide send is implied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Audience-specific slides and notes must be composed around verified technical evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Native layouts remove repeated formatting and bounded drafting can adapt explanations from supplied results.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting a defensible message and responding accurately to unexpected technical questions.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining limitations and reasoning interactively under expert questioning.
tasks.altitude: Less slide composition, with unchanged scientific authorship and presentation responsibility.

reach.task: Adapt an evidence-based explanation to an unfamiliar audience
reach.learn: Audience framing and preservation of scientific uncertainty

evidence.claim: A writing experiment with 453 professionals reported shorter completion time and better rated quality; the participants were not engineers and the result is context, not a conference-task saving.
Source-linked presentation drafting and all conference-specific time shares are model knowledge estimates.

assumptions: Boundary includes source checking, the actual slides and notes, final checking and live presentation. Travel and conference administration are not credited. Research production is an existing input, not removed work; no trailing conference report is invented.

The engineer selects result ID, source version, figure reference, units and uncertainty in s1, retaining 18 hours of evidence work. The engineer produces the message and scope in s2, then captures and corrects actual slide content in s3's retained 15 hours. Source figures are reused as supplied, not regenerated from a prose model.

Existing disclosure conditions come from the current project or publication agreement; s4 counts checking their application. Missing permission or unclear evidence requires manual resolution before presentation. No new institutional approval layer is assumed.

Test native slide layouts and existing figure links before custom code. Ordinary author saves have no approval stage or saving; the gate binds the external presentation to the checked final version, with live answers requiring human judgement.
unknowns: Actual preparation time relative to presentation time
Availability of reusable permitted figures and current templates
research_questions: Does slide drafting reduce total composition and correction time while preserving uncertainty and technical accuracy?

already_counted.description: Verify selected evidence, correct slide content and check the final presentation

incremental.description: Maintain the template and sample source-figure and claim accuracy

approvals.approved_version: Exact final slide and note version with its figures and disclosure scope checked in s4; edits require a new check, and live answers remain the engineer's current judgement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=88, gross=12, upkeep=1.5, net=10.5. Cautious case: novel results retain all 20 evidence hours and a specialist audience retains 22.5 of 25 slide-writing hours; all other 55 hours stay, giving 2.5 gross minus 1.5 upkeep =1. High 6 retains additional explanation correction beyond central.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Choose the article's technical argument, scope and intended publication
Review and verify the article's technical evidence and references
Write for technical magazines, journals and trade association publications

loop.purpose: Compose article prose from the engineer's chosen argument and verified evidence
loop.input: argument outline, checked source passages, results and publication requirements
loop.check: Engineer checks mathematical and materials claims, units, causal language, uncertainty and each reference against the actual source
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unverified references or unsupported conclusions are removed or written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: An original technical explanation requires case-specific prose and argument structure

steps.what: Check the complete article, figures, references and submission conditions
Send the final article package to the publication editor

tasks.design: Use a publication template and a checked reference collection in {DOCS}, with a bounded article draft from the engineer's actual argument and findings. The engineer checks the complete package and separately submits it through {EMAIL}; no automatic publication or invented reference is accepted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical prose and publication formatting must be built around the engineer's original argument.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates remove layout work and bounded drafting can express supplied evidence without choosing the scientific contribution.
tasks.still_hard: Original interpretation, defensible claims and accurate disclosure of limitations.
tasks.human_edge: Standing behind the article's argument and knowing when evidence does not support a conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Less prose assembly, with unchanged authorship and technical responsibility.

reach.task: Check whether an article's claims and references are supported
reach.learn: Publication requirements and scientific source verification

evidence.claim: The Noy and Zhang writing experiment involved 453 professionals and reported time and quality improvements; it did not measure materials-engineering articles.
Bounded technical-article drafting, reference reuse and all local time estimates are model knowledge designs.

assumptions: Boundary includes choosing the argument, verifying sources, the actual article write, final checking and submission. Producing the underlying research and later editorial peer review are outside this focal baseline and receive no saving; ordinary author saves have no approval stage.

The engineer produces the argument in s1 and verifies source ID, passage, result version, figure, units and uncertainty in s2, retaining 17 hours of evidence work. s3 retains 22 hours to capture and correct technical prose; references not in the checked collection are not generated as facts.

s4 retains all final scientific, figure and reference checks and confirms editor address, attachment versions and relevant publication or disclosure conditions. Missing evidence or unclear submission conditions require manual resolution before s5. No additional organisational approval is invented.
Test native publication and reference templates before custom code. The send is a distinct external action and stays fully retained; no automated release is implied.
unknowns: Current time spent composing and correcting technical prose
Availability of reusable publication templates and verified reference records
research_questions: Does drafting reduce total article-writing time after full technical and citation correction?

already_counted.description: Verify article evidence and correct and check the complete manuscript

incremental.description: Maintain source-linked drafting conventions and sample unsupported technical claims

approvals.approved_version: Exact final article, figures, references, attachments and editor recipient checked in s4; any change invalidates submission approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=79, gross=21, upkeep=2, net=19. Cautious case: specialised references require all 20 evidence hours and novel technical explanations retain 36 of 40 writing hours; all other 40 hours stay, giving 4 gross minus 2 upkeep =2. High 12 retains more manuscript correction than central.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The materials engineer retains design decisions and scientific argument while reducing selected drawing and prose assembly.
reach: Work with drafters and technical editors to preserve source meaning across drawings and publications
role.ambitious_version: Clearer engineering designs and technical explanations with human responsibility for their evidence and limits.
